notablePrerequisites:
Scaled Herbalist does not have summoning sickness.
You have a land card in hand.
description:
Activate Scaled Herbalist by tapping it, putting a land card from your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Aesi and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Scaled Herbalist.
Resolve the Aesi trigger, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a land card and put it into your hand.
Repeat.
